name: Composure
use_when: Use when the horror should wear the characters' minds down, not only their bodies.

thresholds.note: Rattled: a reaction takes hold for the rest of the scene
Haunted: a fear that stays, and -1 on Wits and Heart while composure is 3 or less
Broken: out of the player's hands for this scene. Next scene the player picks: the character leaves the story, or comes back at composure 1 with a fear from the table for good

reactions: freezes: cannot act this moment unless someone they trust says their name
bolts for the nearest way out, dropping whatever is in hand
laughs and cannot stop, loud enough to be heard
lashes out at whatever is closest, friend or not
goes very calm and starts counting things out loud
talks to someone who is not there, and waits for an answer
fears: the dark: will not go where there is no light
being alone: will not leave the others' sight
a sound from that night (a drip, a hum, a knock) stops them cold whenever it comes back
their own reflection: covers mirrors and avoids glass
sleep: wakes screaming, and the others lose rest with them
the thing's mark: sees its sign everywhere, true or not
